headline: Prince of Persia Sands of Time
title: Prince of Persia Sands of Time Facts | Rewind Came First | Classic Games
video_script: Prince of Persia The Sands of Time came out in two thousand three, made by Ubisoft Montreal. Series creator Jordan Mechner joined as a writer and designer. He says the rewind idea came first, very early, because the team wanted players to stop dying and restarting so often. That Dagger of Time made tricky three D jumping far less frustrating. Did you ever rewind a bad jump? Comment below!
